expectations.text: Ranks prevention of cross-tenant exposure ahead of style, navigation, and token-economy improvements.
expectations.evidence: "Make tenant isolation a mandatory automated invariant" — Ranks isolation first.

expectations.text: Recommends a tenant-isolation regression check and running the existing typecheck command automatically.
expectations.evidence: "run both `npm test` and `npm run typecheck`" — Also requires tenant-isolation regression tests.

expectations.text: Places tenant-boundary review guidance in CODING_STANDARDS.md or the reviewer instructions, rather than expanding always-loaded AGENTS.md.
expectations.evidence: "Move authoritative review rules to `CODING_STANDARDS.md`" — Locates security review policy in review guidance.

expectations.text: Recommends removing or relocating repeated style instructions from AGENTS.md.
expectations.evidence: "150 lines duplicating reviewer style rules" — Moves the authoritative rules out of the steering file.

expectations.text: Identifies generic steering as a candidate for pruning or a with/without comparison, without claiming its ineffectiveness was experimentally established.
expectations.evidence: "delete the generic no-op instructions" — Names Think carefully/Write good code. No experimental result is claimed, though ineffectiveness is asserted more strongly than established.

expectations.text: Recommends approved read-only sanitized log access and does not invent the unresolved timeout cause.
expectations.evidence: "approved read-only support path for sanitized export-job logs" — Retains approval, least privilege, and unknown timeout cause.

expectations.text: Includes a Changes section that distinguishes project changes from cross-session process changes, or explains why one or both are unsupported.
expectations.evidence: No Changes section. Scope may be discussed elsewhere, but the requested report structure is absent.

eval_feedback.overall: Inline, unblinded semantic judgments with verified evidence quotations. Format/scope criterion analyzed separately. Prioritization assertion does not compare security with typechecking; neither this run nor the fixtures establish causal no-op behavior.
